title: Anterior Shoulder Stabilisation, p33 Wall slides
provider: Oxford University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust, OMI81702 Oct2023
protocol: Face wall. Place little-finger edges on wall with thumbs pointing backward. Paper towel optional. Slide hands smoothly up wall within comfortable range and gradually higher. Starting assistance at elbow optional.
variant: Standing bilateral little-finger edge wall slides, palms inward and thumbs backward, feet and torso fixed; no towel, no assisting hand.
limitations: Source is postsurgical rehabilitation leaflet; candidate uses movement description only, not surgical timing or clinical treatment. Demonstration ROM/8second timing are not source prescription.
